configuration.env_overrides: documented config-secret/ephemeral-path precedence only; command env remains owner-open and has no key/value allowlist
configuration.path_and_key_rules: relative paths in the owner-open config resolve against explicit profile root; command cwd, spool and target paths are not restricted to that root; duplicate keys and escaping are configuration errors; publication is temp_fsync_rename_fsync

ingress.host_allocation_scope: only provider-native or transparent tool events inside an already correlated owner-open turn; standalone client turn.start and control frames follow their documented payload requirements
ingress.malformed_frame_boundary: only framing/encoding ambiguity is invalid_frame; the host may allocate missing bookkeeping correlation for a native or transparent tool event inside an existing turn, while a standalone client turn.start/control frame remains invalid_frame when its documented fields are absent
ingress.multi_client: owner_configured_concurrent_turns_use_separate_connections; each connection carries at most one active turn lineage
ingress.connection_model: one_active_turn_per_connection; hello is an optional connection preface and the hello/ack sequence shares the connection frame order
ingress.trust_model: owner_open_local_peer_trust; any peer with configured socket connectivity can request owner-open effects

hello.context_inheritance: protocol/connection/resume context may be established by hello and inherited by subsequent frames; session/task/turn/user_input are supplied by turn.start
hello.resume_binding: all supplied resume fields must name the same prior turn_stream_id; an invalid or expired cursor returns resume_unavailable without redispatch
hello.resume_tuple_rule: prior_connection_id is legal only with turn_stream_id plus exactly one resume_cursor or resume_token; a partial tuple is invalid_frame
hello.turn_stream_allocation: hello.ack allocates a provisional turn_stream_id; if hello carries no turn, turn.start supplies the session/task/turn payload on the same connection

stream.resume.resume_rule: exactly one of resume_cursor or resume_token is required; both or neither is invalid_frame

ingress.cross_connection_control_context: turn.cancel and tool.cancel inherit profile_id/task_id from the active correlated stream or require them explicitly on a cross-connection request; job.kill and stream controls use the same rule, and a cross-connection job operation supplies an inclusive cursor

control_field_types.cursor: inclusive nonnegative host_seq/event cursor or an opaque durable cursor; required for a cross-connection job operation
control_field_types.initial_window_bytes: owner_configured_nonnegative_integer; zero pauses delivery and spools when possible

control_semantics.resume_cursor_token_rule: hello/turn.start may omit both cursor and token for a new stream; whenever a resume is requested, exactly one of resume_cursor or resume_token is supplied, and both together are invalid_frame
control_semantics.terminal_event: exactly_one_per_call_and_one_turn_end; duplicate delivery is replay only

storage.store_unavailable_behavior: attempt_accepted_started_terminal_append; if the store is unavailable, dispatch the direct call anyway, mark event_log_status=unavailable and the lineage best_effort/unreplayable, and never convert the logging failure into a command denial
storage.event_id_before_durable_commit: host_boot_id_plus_monotonic_counter_or_uuid; stable replay is promised only after the corresponding record is durable; an unpersisted event may be reported as best_effort and is not replay evidence

restart_reconciliation.accepted_only: conservatively report not_started only when the accepted record explicitly proves no spawn attempt; otherwise report unknown_after_disconnect and expose inspect
restart_reconciliation.started_without_terminal: report started_no_response/unknown_after_disconnect according to local process and transport evidence; never redispatch automatically
restart_reconciliation.terminal_record: replay the recorded terminal observation and raw chunks with stable event_id/seq
restart_reconciliation.incomplete_job: reopen as inspectable job; attach or kill is an explicit Codex/owner action
restart_reconciliation.no_record: unknown_after_disconnect when a dispatch could have begun; absence is not proof of not_started

storage.spool_cleanup: explicit spool.cleanup or owner-configured retention after terminal/reconciliation; cleanup failure is io_error observation and does not alter effect state

tool_catalog.transparent_alias_naming_rule: an optional alias is a new neutral raw-byte carrier; it must not reuse a forbidden *stdio-proxy module/name, fixed control FD, SOCK_SEQPACKET closed schema or nonce gate
tool_catalog.unobserved_provider_native_bypass_scope: false means an integrated product may not bypass durable correlation/replay accounting; a developer/bootstrap invocation may still run best_effort without correlation, and is never denied solely for being unobserved
tool_catalog.native_binding_missing_behavior: before dispatch, host fills configured target/cwd/executor metadata or marks the event best_effort and may choose the transparent raw alias; missing metadata never pre-dispatch-denies a command or blocks startup; after native dispatch starts, correlate the native result only and never alias-redispatch
tool_catalog.unobserved_native_effect_rule: an uninstrumented provider-native effect may run best_effort only in the developer/bootstrap owner-open lane; an integrated turn must correlate it or choose the transparent alias before dispatch, and any unobserved effect is outside replay/exactly-once accounting; once it starts the host never redispatches an alias or denies it solely for missing metadata
tool_catalog.native_and_alias_duplicate_dispatch: forbidden; a native Codex tool event is either observed or dispatched through the alias, never both
tool_catalog.integrated_event_capture_rule: an integrated owner-open turn must correlate every native shell event before forwarding it; when the provider cannot expose that event, use the transparent alias for durable observation/replay; a developer bootstrap native call may be marked best_effort

native_event_correlation.algorithm: on first observed native tool event, allocate call_id, resolve target/cwd/identity, compute request_sha256 over exact observed arguments, attempt accepted/started persistence before forwarding output, then reuse those ids for all chunks and terminal result; an unavailable store yields best_effort/unreplayable metadata and does not block dispatch
native_event_correlation.missing_native_ids: host-generated correlation is required; never infer a replayable call from model text alone
native_event_correlation.unobserved_effect: a provider-side process that emits no correlated tool event is outside replay/exactly-once accounting; prefer the transparent alias when durable observation is required

turn.wire_location: payload object of a turn.start frame; envelope correlation fields may mirror these values only when byte-for-byte equivalent after normalization
turn.idempotency_scope: session_id+profile_id+task_id+turn_id; host-assigned turn_stream_id is excluded from the request digest and identical user_input in another turn never attaches to this turn

tool_call.required_scope: call_id and tool are required on a client wire tool_call; provider-native adapter input may omit call_id and is normalized by the host before emitting this schema
tool_call.alias_rules: target and target_id may be equivalent aliases; stream_id and turn_stream_id may be equivalent aliases; both present with different values is invalid_frame

pty.rows_cols: positive_owner_configured_liveness_bounds; initial size is captured in the accepted request
pty.term: owner-configured TERM (default xterm-256color when unset); pty allocation preserves raw bytes and does not normalize CR/LF or echo

shell_job.context_inheritance: session_id/profile_id/task_id/turn_id/turn_stream_id may be inherited from the enclosing run_turn stream; cross-connection operations must supply them explicitly
shell_job.target_id: optional; defaults to configured target and is recorded
shell_job.ttl_ms: optional_nonnegative_integer; zero_or_null_uses_owner_default; expiry is liveness cleanup, not denial
shell_job.command_or_argv: same mutually-exclusive command/argv rules as shell.exec
shell_job.kill_context: session_id is required and profile_id is required across connections; both may be inherited from the active correlated stream
shell_job.ownership: job_id_is_scoped_to_session_id_and_profile_id; later-turn attach/kill requires explicit session_id and profile_id (or inherited active correlated stream context) and cursor
shell_job.cross_connection_fields: session_id, profile_id and job_id are explicit for every operation; cursor is inclusive and may be inherited on the active stream but is required when any operation is issued outside that stream
shell_job.ttl: liveness_cleanup_only_not_authorization; monotonic clock starts at accepted_record and does not imply remote cancellation

client_resume_cursor.meaning: last contiguous client seq acknowledged by host

run_turn_frame.context_rule: hello establishes protocol/connection/resume context; turn.start payload establishes protocol/session/task/turn and the host confirms the provisional turn_stream_id from hello.ack when present (or allocates it for a direct turn); subsequent frames inherit and may repeat it
run_turn_frame.sequence_scope: directional sequence: client seq is monotonic per connection, while host/event seq is monotonic per turn_stream across reconnects and is the inclusive replay cursor; direction is inferred from the transport role when omitted
run_turn_frame.seq_semantics: serialized seq is direction-dependent; client_seq and host_seq are optional diagnostic mirrors, and host_seq is the persisted replay cursor
run_turn_frame.eof_semantics: stream.eof follows terminal event; reconciliation is delivered before eof or through event.read on a resumed stream; reconnect never reexecutes
run_turn_frame.unknown_or_future_kinds: transport-valid opaque frames; forward or report only mechanical decode errors, never a semantic denial

first_frame.payload_location: hello and turn.start request fields live in payload; top-level correlation aliases are accepted only when equal; host ack metadata is top-level
first_frame.host_assigned_identity_rule: client cannot mint connection_id, turn_stream_id, event_id, server_request_id or host_seq; supplied host-owned values are ignored/replaced on a new request and are accepted only when they match the corresponding inherited replay context, otherwise invalid_frame
first_frame.seq: direct turn.start: client seq=0 and host turn.accepted host_seq=0; hello preface: hello/hello.ack use connection-control seq=0 and are outside the persisted turn cursor, then client turn.start seq=1 and host turn.accepted starts host_seq=0; later host events continue host_seq=1; after reconnect client seq may reset but host_seq never rewinds
first_frame.handshake_seq_scope: hello and hello.ack are connection-control frames; only an accepted turn and its events consume the persisted turn_stream host_seq
first_frame.allocator: client serializes its client seq per connection; host serializes and persists host_seq per turn_stream; a replay never allocates a new seq
first_frame.host_generated_metadata: connection_id, turn_stream_id, event_id and server_request_id may be absent on client frames and are assigned by host; turn.accepted returns server_request_id for reconnect-safe dedupe
first_frame.turn_idempotency: client_request_id_or_turn_request_sha256 is required for reconnect-safe turn dedupe; if both are absent the host assigns a request id and records it before provider start; same scoped id with different canonical bytes is invalid_frame
first_frame.feature_negotiation: opaque feature labels; unsupported optional feature is reported, never a policy denial
first_frame.resume: when prior_connection_id is supplied, the reconnect hello or turn.start must also supply a matching turn_stream_id and exactly one inclusive resume_cursor or resume_token; the host binds all fields to one prior lineage before replay
first_frame.ack_for: hello.ack acknowledges hello; turn.accepted acknowledges turn.start; both carry their direction-specific seq and a payload with negotiated context

wire_rules.subsequent_frame_context: protocol/session/task/turn/stream/event correlation is inherited only after a valid first frame; missing required correlation then yields invalid_frame

payload_shapes.ack_alias_rule: host ack fields listed as top_level_fields are canonical; if repeated inside payload they must be equal byte-for-byte after normalization

job.kill.profile_rule: profile_id/task_id may be inherited on the same active correlated stream; a cross-connection kill supplies them explicitly and includes an inclusive cursor

stream.resume.resume_rule: exactly one of resume_cursor or resume_token is required; both or neither is invalid_frame

sequence.direction: client requests use connection-local seq; host events use a persisted turn_stream host_seq
sequence.concurrent_writes: one writer per direction serializes frames; client validates next connection seq and host validates next persisted host_seq
sequence.client_duplicate: host computes a canonical frame digest when frame_sha256 is absent; same seq and same canonical bytes/digest is acknowledged/replayed, while same seq with different bytes is invalid_frame
sequence.sequence_mirror_rule: when client_seq or host_seq mirrors are present they must equal the direction-specific canonical seq; a mismatch is invalid_frame, and absent mirrors are filled diagnostically by the host
sequence.missing_frame_digest: wire omission is allowed, but normalized canonical bytes are hashed before duplicate comparison and persistence

request_digest.input: canonicalized requested envelope preserving exact command/argv/stdin bytes, requested target hint and config_generation; resolved binding is recorded separately
request_digest.canonicalization: RFC8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS, RFC 8785) over UTF-8 JSON after schema normalization; object keys lexicographic, arrays ordered, omitted/default/null rules versioned, digest fields omitted
request_digest.canonicalization_profile: trillionnium-jcs-r3: normalize documented target aliases, fill omitted mode/pty/stream defaults and the host-snapshotted config_generation, normalize omitted or explicit-null profile_id to the selected default, omit absent optional fields, preserve explicit null for other fields, sort env object keys, preserve array order, canonical base64 padding
request_digest.config_generation_snapshot: when omitted by the caller, host records the active generation before hashing and uses that same generation for dispatch; a reload applies only at a later turn/job boundary
request_digest.binary_encoding: command/argv/env strings are UTF-8 without NUL; stdin and PTY bytes are represented as base64 with RFC4648 canonical padding; env keys are sorted and duplicate keys are invalid
request_digest.digest_scope: include protocol/version, session_id, profile_id, task_id, turn_id, tool, config_generation, requested target hint, mode, exact argv or command, cwd, env, stdin descriptor/content, timeout, normalized PTY and stream options; exclude client/server request IDs, parent/continuation/resume/stream/connection/event IDs, resolved endpoint, binding fingerprint, seq mirrors, timestamps and digest fields
request_digest.binding_fingerprint: after target resolution compute and persist a separate fingerprint over resolved endpoint, transport identity, target boot/serial when known, profile_id and config_generation; same_call_id dedupe requires both request_sha256 and binding_fingerprint to match
request_digest.supplied_binding_mismatch: invalid_frame_binding_conflict; host recomputes the resolved fingerprint and never trusts a caller-provided value
request_digest.null_behavior: local_call_id_deduplication_only until restart; after restart, a missing durable dispatch record returns unknown_after_disconnect (durable P1 records may be replayed)

shell_mode.nul: command/argv/env strings are UTF-8 without NUL; stdin and PTY bytes may contain NUL

variants.base64_data: RFC4648 decode with padding accepted; decoded bytes exact
variants.fd: fd_id belongs to selected target namespace and is CLOEXEC unless close_after=false
variants.spool_path: path resolves in selected target namespace and is read as bytes

pty.object_precedence: enabled/rows/cols/term override boolean form; term defaults to owner-configured xterm-256color and an explicit env.TERM wins for the effective process environment

chunks_and_spool.spool: owner_configured target-scoped path, permissioned to Codex, retained through restart until explicit cleanup
chunks_and_spool.physical_full: emit partial chunks plus resource_exhausted; never silently truncate or retry

remote_reconciliation.terminal_rule: late knowledge updates the original effect_state and never emits a second terminal event

turn_end.summary: model/host text or null; no actions/refusal schema
turn_end.failure_before_terminal: persist one interrupted_or_unknown_after_disconnect terminal when possible; if persistence is unavailable expose the lineage as resumable without inventing success

wire_rules.job_scope: session/profile scoped; target_id is optional and defaults to configured target; a later turn attaches with explicit session_id, job_id and inclusive cursor; turn_id is not an ownership barrier
wire_rules.reboot_rule: if agent_host_location=rootlinux, phone reboot interrupts host and reverse; resume is a new turn_id with continuation_of; an independent host_linux supervisor may retain the stream

effect_state.meaning: knowledge about the selected remote/target effect, independent of local dispatch/process state

conditional_non_null_rules.accepted_call: call-scope observations have non-null call/session/turn/target fields after host correlation; the resolved_target key is required but nullable until endpoint resolution has been observed, and may remain null for a pre-resolution transport failure
conditional_non_null_rules.pre_resolution_transport_or_frame_error: use scope=frame or scope=turn and permit call_id, target, resolved_target and turn_stream_id to be null; do not manufacture empty identifiers
conditional_non_null_rules.target_unavailable_after_accepted_dispat: retain the requested target and set resolved_target null only when resolution was never observed; effect_state is not_attempted or unknown according to dispatch evidence

chunk_fields.pty_stream_rule: stream=pty and stdout/stderr are merged when pty is enabled; byte_count counts decoded bytes represented by data or the referenced spool

observation_schema.parse_or_ingress_error: scope=frame_or_turn; call_id_and_target_may_be_null; never synthesize empty identifiers

recovery.endpoint_shape: owner-only local control socket or physical/ADB recovery path outside Codex namespace
recovery.marker_shape: persistent owner_open_respawn_inhibit with explicit clear; init must not immediately respawn while set
recovery.rootlinux_reboot: Codex_and_host_die_with_phone; mark interrupted and resume with a new turn_id unless an independent host supervisor is configured

adb.exec.artifact_requirement: a real ARM64 userspace platform-tools adb client with its runtime libraries/server/USB transport, or a byte-transparent host-server relay; packages/modules/adb adb is cc_binary_host and adbd alone is not a Root Linux client
adb.exec.typed_helper_is_not_adb: vendor/trillionnium/prebuilt/common/linux/agent-direct-tools/trillionnium-agent-adb is a legacy typed BackendUnavailable adapter and must not satisfy this requirement

operation.inspect.profile_rule: profile_id may be inherited on the active authenticated stream; a cross-connection inspect supplies session_id and profile_id explicitly

event.read.profile_rule: profile_id may be inherited on the active authenticated stream; a cross-connection read supplies session_id and profile_id explicitly

spool.cleanup.target_id: optional; infer from call/job record when absent and record the resolved target

status_effect_mapping.scope: call_observation_defaults_only; turn/frame/provider lifecycle statuses use turn_status_values and do not overwrite a prior call effect_state
status_effect_mapping.meaning: each entry is a conservative default; dispatch_state describes local process/transport observation, while effect_state describes what the selected target is known to have done

io_error.maintenance_or_event_log_io: report io_error for the maintenance operation and preserve the prior call dispatch_state/effect_state

effect_state_values.possibly_applied: dispatch may have reached the target but completion is not known
effect_state_values.applied: target or local process acknowledged execution; this does not mean semantic success
effect_state_values.rejected: target explicitly returned a rejection before applying the requested effect
effect_state_values.unknown: transport or power loss prevents a conclusion

product_graph.forbidden_owner_open_module_closure_rule: a listed closure fails when its edge is resolved or linked by the selected owner-open Soong/Cargo graph, even if no resulting APK or binary is installed; replace it with a separately named neutral codec/mechanism module
product_graph.forbidden_owner_open_sdk_edge_rule: the complete listed edge set must be profile-gated or replaced by separately named neutral owner-open codec/mechanism modules before common product evaluation; verify every edge in Soong module-info, resolved framework/service/app classpaths and target-files, because an unresolved or linked legacy SDK edge fails convergence even when its APK is not installed
product_graph.forbidden_owner_open_sdk_source_rule: profile-gate or refactor every listed framework source/resource consumer before removing the legacy SDK; replace Trillionnium identity/lease/replay/policy classes and R resources with neutral APIs or an owner-open-specific source set, then compile and inspect services.core/services jars and classpaths

forbidden_owner_open_init_conditions.fogos_custom_os_agent: failure_when_started_or_connected_to_turn; passive diagnostic definition is allowed only when not started and not connected

product_graph.forbidden_scope_rule: forbidden_owner_open_nodes are exact module/service names, while forbidden_name_patterns are case-insensitive pattern matches; a match is a failure only when reachable from the selected owner-open Cargo/Soong/init/compiled-policy/target-files graph; passive sealed source, historical tests and custody artifacts may retain the text

profile_selection.aosp_product_variable_freeze: build/make/core/product.mk freezes _product_var_list/_product_single_value_vars before product imports; register PRODUCT_TRILLINNIUM_AGENT_PROFILE before that point or export an equivalent build/Soong input before parsing
profile_selection.trillionnium_hook_condition: build/make/core/config.mk currently includes vendor/trillionnium/config/BoardConfigTrillionnium.mk only when TRILLINNIUM_BUILD is non-empty
profile_selection.direct_build_without_input: configuration_error_or_unconditional_selected_product_hook; never silently evaluate the legacy/common package graph

product_graph.sealed_history_rule: forbidden nodes may exist only behind an explicit sealed/legacy target and must not be linked, installed, started or imported by owner-open

verification.direct_smoke_serial: use ANDROID_SERIAL when explicitly configured; otherwise discover a serial from adb devices and retain ZY32JLVHGN only as the observed lab default; the host-side interpolation never authorizes or rewrites an adb.exec argv
verification.same_turn_proof: event stream contains user input, tool_call exact bytes, observation and continuation in one turn
